name: Arroyomolinos de León (Spain)
description: White field with a red horizontal stripe across the centre, charged with the crowned municipal arms of Arroyomolinos de León (a millwheel and a sword on white above waves).
history: Municipal flag of Arroyomolinos de León; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Arroyomolinos de León arms — millwheel and sword above waves
